name: Shoko MPC-HC
overview: Play episodes in MPC-HC directly from the Shoko Web UI. Includes one-time Windows link-handler setup.

releases.release_notes: Show readable filenames in MPC-HC. Update Windows Setup for named streams. Targets Shoko 6 dev.550 / Abstractions alpha.112. Requires one-time Windows setup. No watch-state sync or external subtitle handoff.
